proposal.backtest_or_simulation_evidence: BTC route-specific frozen studies plus HYPE causal alignment replay; see cited journals and immutable reports.
proposal.live_or_forward_evidence: One later BTC Hulk short, one later BTC sweep long, one later HYPE aligned long, and one prospective HYPE aligned short; samples remain sparse.

proposal.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any identity mismatch, unexpected route, unprotected position, accounting contamination, HYPE opposed/unavailable entry, repeated after-cost route losses, or material execution-cost divergence.
proposal.confidence_level: high on technical route retirement and profile composition; low-to-medium on profitability
